name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: A menu of actions triggered by a button — items, submenus, separators, labels, shortcuts, and checkbox/radio selections.

meta.whenToUse: A button-triggered menu of actions — row actions (edit/duplicate/delete), account menus, view toggles.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single-value form input (Select), page navigation (nav/menubar), or a persistent always-visible action list.
